text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
On the day of the meeting, Kawakami 
Princess showed up with a scowl on her 
face.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Gugigigi...! My head is still throbbing~!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
*sniff, sniff*! *inhale*! Mmm, smells like 
a true princess...!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
My usual rose bath is lovely, but incense 
and cologne are so soothing too~!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Roses are so beautiful, yet their thorns 
are super tough—just like a warrior 
princess...!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Aha, inspiration strikes! All these 
rose-scented goods I've gathered...

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
If we use them all in one big burst, I'm 
sure we'll feel the roses even more 
intensely...!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
This sweet fragrance is skyrocketing my 
super-duper princess level!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
"...So when I tried them all at once, it 
was overkill, and now my head hurts 
terribly..."

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Ehh... Even after airing it out, my head 
still aches!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Ouch...! Ngh... screaming made it hurt 
again...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Perhaps the headaches had become 
habitual, for she was tormented by the 
pain..."
